title: Help's stop shows once and stops Help while a /help answer streams, with or without the microphone or chat-input
steps: S1: Load @tracy/dsh-assistant and @tracy/dsh-chat-input over a stand-in dsh whose conversation.input.activity keeps the single-slot rule; /api/speech answers available=false; a Help answer of session s1 is streaming. Render the seat and click .tv-help-stop.
S2: Same, with voice switched off by the operator (composer-voice-input hidden).
S4: No Help answer streaming, voice available; then voice unavailable.
S5: Load @tracy/dsh-assistant alone (no chat-input); render the seat idle, then with a Help answer streaming, and click .tv-help-stop.
expect: S1: the seat holds .tv-help-stop with the stop label and no microphone; the click calls Help's stopAll.
S3: one .tv-voice-seat row holding .tv-voice, then .tv-help-stop, and exactly one .tv-help-stop.
S4: the microphone alone and no .tv-help-stop; then only an empty .tv-voice-seat row.
S5: idle draws nothing; streaming draws exactly one .tv-help-stop and no microphone; the click calls stopAll.
evidence: #1379: on the dev deployment the seat was empty while /help streamed; the microphone at priority -1 held the single slot
fence: Both real plugin bundles over a stand-in single slot that renders only the lowest priority

tests: Help streaming with voice registered but no speech key
Help streaming with voice switched off by the operator
Help without chat-input on the profile
